analyzed_vuln.description: OptimizeMatrixShaper assumes matrix stage payloads are full 3x3 doubles and unconditionally casts _cmsStageMatrixData::Double to cmsMAT3* before calling _cmsMAT3per. For this PoV, a malformed/unsupported matrix stage (coming from fuzzed profiles) carries a smaller Double buffer (24 bytes), but the optimizer still treats it as cmsMAT3 (72 bytes). _cmsMAT3per then reads past the heap allocation, causing the ASan heap-buffer-overflow. The crash is in _cmsMAT3per, but the root cause is missing size/shape validation in OptimizeMatrixShaper before matrix multiplication.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered via cms_transform_all_fuzzer when attacker-controlled ICC profile data is linked into a pipeline that matches the optimizer pattern (curve-matrix-[matrix]-curve), so OptimizeMatrixShaper runs. The matrix stage(s) must have inconsistent dimensions or truncated matrix payload (e.g., not true 3x3) while still being accepted into the pipeline. During optimization, Data->Double is cast to cmsMAT3* and multiplied, leading to out-of-bounds read.
